_comment: v1.13.3 - the last Bellum Alexandrinum batch: eleven chapters from 34-78, which closes the work at 25 and Hirtius at 45. Four theatres, as the book has them: Asia Minor (36, 40 - Domitius Calvinus and Pharnaces, the defeat at Nicopolis), Illyricum (43, 46 - Gabinius's winter disaster, Vatinius's naval gamble off Tauris), Spain (48, 52, 56, 64 - Q. Cassius Longinus: the bought army, the knifing at Corduba, his reaction to Pharsalus, his drowning at the Ebro mouth), and Zela (74, 75, 77). All eleven are whole chapters. Subsection boundaries from Damon's LDLT edition. Source faults found by a word-by-word comparison with that edition, not by guessing patterns.
ba.40: Signo sub idem tempus ab utroque
ba.46: Vatinius cum animum adverteret neque navium
ba.48: Eis autem temporibus quibus Caesar ad Dyrrachium
ba.52: Exercitu coacto in unum locum castris ad Cordubam
ba.56: Aliquot post diebus litteras a Caesare
ba.74: Pharnaces, cum id repente prima luce
adversus arduum collem instructis copiis coepit.
ba.77: cum Caelio Viniciano in Ponto relinquit.
